name: u1-base-fm175xx-reader
title: U1 Base: RFID reader
author: bespoked
description:
Part of the U1 Base Layer. On its own it changes nothing you can see: it opens the printer's RFID reader to plugins so that other plugins can use it.

What it opens:
• A plugin can claim a card the printer could not read, so a tag the stock reader does not understand is still handled instead of being dropped.
• A plugin can register a handler for a card type, and can talk to the card through the printer's own reader, including NTAG pages and MIFARE Classic blocks.

With no plugin registered, the reader behaves exactly as it does today. Install this because a plugin you want asks for it. Under the hood it edits Klipper's own program files on the printer. Uninstalling puts the originals back, and it re-applies itself after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Opens the printer's RFID reader to plugins. Alone it changes nothing.
attributions:
# Attributions - u1-base-fm175xx-reader

**Plugin author:** paxx12 (Extended Firmware overlay `13-patch-rfid`), packaged and extended by Bespok3d

The patch in this package is applied to Snapmaker's Klipper fork, which is GPL-3.0, so the patch is
GPL-3.0-only as well. About a fifth of the lines it adds come from `03-fm175xx-reader-enabled-guard.patch`
in the Extended Firmware overlay `13-patch-rfid`; the patch file itself records that origin in its
header.
